fieldDescription: Opens the full-screen StarNotes window on the campaign map. StarNotes is also always in the [Intel] screen, under [Exploration].

defaultValue:
- [Mouse wheel]: zoom toward the cursor
- [Right-drag]: pan the map
- [Ctrl + Z]: undo the last change
- [Click a tool again]: open its options (colours, sizes, symbols)
- [Ctrl + A / C / X / V]: select all, copy, cut and paste in notes
- [Shift + arrows] or drag: select text in notes
- [Esc]: close StarNotes
